Item.Name: Response
Item.Description:
Textual response produced by the most recent RECLAIM command issued through this object's Command resource. Used by troubleshooting subcommands (RECLAIM:count, RECLAIM:<logger>, RECLAIM:i,<idx>, RECLAIM:clear) to return their results, and by RECLAIM:<logger>,<start>,<stop> to report success or error.
Formats (plain text, key=value): - count=<n> - idx=<i>,logger=<id>,start=<u>,stop=<u>,created=<u> - count=<m>\nidx=<i>,start=<u>,stop=<u>,created=<u>\n... (list per logger) - OK / OK,evicted=1 / OK,cleared=<n> - ERR:<errno-name> (e.g. ERR:EINVAL, ERR:ENOENT, ERR:ENOMEM)
Output is truncated to 511 characters with a trailing "..." marker if it would exceed the buffer.
